# conductorone_credential_inventory_policy (Resource)

CredentialInventoryPolicy Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "conductorone_credential_inventory_policy" "my_credentialinventorypolicy" {
  credential_inventory_policy_service_delete_request = {
    # ...
  }
  delegated = {
    google_enabled = true
    google_hosted_domains = [
      "..."
    ]
    microsoft_enabled = true
    microsoft_tenant_ids = [
      "..."
    ]
  }
  display_name = "...my_display_name..."
  email_otp = {
    code_length  = 8
    max_attempts = 0
    ttl_seconds  = 0
  }
  enabled_types = [
    "CREDENTIAL_TYPE_EMAIL_OTP"
  ]
  passkey = {
    allowed_aaguids = [
      "..."
    ]
    attestation               = "ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_UNSPECIFIED"
    require_user_verification = false
  }
  password = {
    check_breached     = false
    history_depth      = 1
    min_length         = 2
    require_mixed_case = false
    require_number     = false
    require_symbol     = false
  }
  priority = 0
  totp = {
    code_length    = 5
    period_seconds = 6
    skew_tolerance = 0
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) A human-readable name for the policy.

### Optional

- `credential_inventory_policy_service_delete_request` (Attributes) The CredentialInventoryPolicyServiceDeleteRequest message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential_inventory_policy_service_delete_request))
- `delegated` (Attributes) DelegatedConstraints controls which third-party sign-in providers are
 accepted as proof of email ownership, and how they are scoped. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegated))
- `email_otp` (Attributes) EmailOTPConstraints configures one-time codes delivered by email. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_otp))
- `enabled_types` (List of String) The credential types users are permitted to enroll under this policy.
- `passkey` (Attributes) PasskeyConstraints controls how users may enroll passkeys (FIDO2 / WebAuthn). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--passkey))
- `password` (Attributes) PasswordConstraints sets the complexity rules a user's password must satisfy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--password))
- `priority` (Number) When a user matches more than one policy, the policy with the highest
 priority applies.
- `totp` (Attributes) TOTPConstraints configures authenticator-app one-time codes (RFC 6238). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--totp))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the policy.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True for built-in policies provided by ConductorOne. Built-in policies
 cannot be edited or deleted.
- `updated_at` (String)

### Nested Schema for `credential_inventory_policy_service_delete_request`


<a id="nestedatt--delegated"></a>
### Nested Schema for `delegated`

Optional:

- `google_enabled` (Boolean) Accept "Sign in with Google".
- `google_hosted_domains` (List of String) Restrict Google sign-in to these Google Workspace domains. Empty = any domain.
- `microsoft_enabled` (Boolean) Accept "Sign in with Microsoft".
- `microsoft_tenant_ids` (List of String) Restrict Microsoft sign-in to these Microsoft tenant IDs. Empty = any tenant.


<a id="nestedatt--email_otp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_otp`

Optional:

- `code_length` (Number) Number of digits in each code.
- `max_attempts` (Number) Number of incorrect attempts allowed before the code is invalidated.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a code remains valid, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--passkey"></a>
### Nested Schema for `passkey`

Optional:

- `allowed_aaguids` (List of String) Allowed authenticator models, by AAGUID. Leave empty to permit any
 authenticator.
- `attestation` (String) How strictly the authenticator's origin must be attested. possible known values include one of ["ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_UNSPECIFIED", "ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_NONE", "ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_INDIRECT", "ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_DIRECT", "ATTESTATION_REQUIREMENT_ENTERPRISE"]
- `require_user_verification` (Boolean) Require the authenticator to verify the user (PIN or biometric) at enrollment.


<a id="nestedatt--password"></a>
### Nested Schema for `password`

Optional:

- `check_breached` (Boolean) Reject passwords found in known-breach corpora.
- `history_depth` (Number) Number of previous passwords to remember and disallow reuse of.
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum length, in characters.
- `require_mixed_case` (Boolean) Require both uppercase and lowercase letters.
- `require_number` (Boolean) Require at least one digit.
- `require_symbol` (Boolean) Require at least one symbol.


<a id="nestedatt--totp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `totp`

Optional:

- `code_length` (Number) Number of digits in each code.
- `period_seconds` (Number) How often a new code is generated, in seconds (typically 30 or 60).
- `skew_tolerance` (Number) How many adjacent time windows to accept, to tolerate clock drift.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = conductorone_credential_inventory_policy.my_conductorone_credential_inventory_policy
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conductorone_credential_inventory_policy.my_conductorone_credential_inventory_policy "..."
```
